genre.zh: 日系家電生活型錄（BALMUDA、無印良品那種）
genre.en: a Japanese home-appliance lifestyle catalogue in the manner of BALMUDA and MUJI: a real lived-in home, quiet daylight, one person using the product naturally

s: the cabin stands in a calm sage-green room on pale oak floor, low late-afternoon sun from a side window laying long warm stripes across its wooden slats and the wall behind
a close angle on the open cabin door, warm amber glow inside, hard window light cutting one clean diagonal shadow across the terracotta wall beside it
a folded linen towel and a glass of water rest on a stool beside the cabin, sun through blinds striping the cabin front and the dusty-rose wall

the product lies on its side on a rust-orange yoga mat on a gym floor, hard overhead-left spotlight from a high window throwing its long cylinder shadow across the mat, a pair of bare feet and calves resting on top of it, the rest of the gym softly blurred behind

the product stands upright on a bare wooden physio-clinic treatment bench against a deep-teal painted wall, a single hard low sun beam from the right window casting its sharp shadow up the wall, the snow-camo pattern fully visible and large in frame

an athlete's hamstring pressed down on the product on a rubber-tiled home-gym floor, deep-navy wall behind, one hard side light from the left carving the camo pattern and a crisp elongated shadow across the tiles

the product rests on a gym bag and running shoes in a locker-room bench corner against a tomato-red locker door, hard flash-like light from the upper right throwing sharp shadows of the roller and shoe laces onto the bench

the product sits beside its USB charging cable on a worn wooden bench of a trail-side rest stop, a muted sage-green wall behind, hard late-afternoon sun from the left laying the roller's long shadow across the planks

the product stands on a yoga mat on a gym floor against a deep-sea-blue wall, hard side light from the left window casting a crisp diamond-wave-textured shadow and the roller's long shadow across the mat, the roller filling most of the frame

a runner's back rolling on the product on a wooden floor of a home training corner, terracotta-orange wall behind, hard low afternoon sun from the right throwing long sharp shadows of the roller and the body across the floor

the product lies on a rubber-tiled floor at a track-side stretching area next to a pair of worn running shoes, mint-green wall behind, hard overhead sun from the upper left giving sharp shadows and showing the 3D diamond waves in relief

the product leans against a squat rack post on a gym platform, a tomato-red painted wall behind, one hard spotlight from the right-above making its shadow stretch across the plywood platform, roller large and central in frame

four rollers in grey, wine, army-green and navy lined up on a gym's black rubber floor in front of a mustard-yellow wall, hard raking light from the left throwing four long parallel shadows across the floor
